citations.assessment: The Yerushalmi explicitly names Shalman and Zavdi as brothers, both sons of Levi, and gives the transmission from R. Yehoshua ben Levi.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

notes.text: The Yerushalmi confirms both the kinship and the transmission.
